text: たたかい　おわっても　ねたまま　ねむけざましで　めが　さめます

structure.jp: たたかい　おわっても

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても means 'even if or even when'. おわっても = 'even after it ends'.

patterns.name: 〜まま
patterns.explanation: まま means staying in the same state. ねたまま = 'while still asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で shows the means. ねむけざましで = 'with an Awakening'.
